profile_text: With a focus on integrated facility management, this German-based service provider delivers a range of essential services including cleaning, security, and technical maintenance to diverse industries. As a result of its specialized offerings, the company has achieved a notable 19.6% growth since its baseline, driven by increasing demand for streamlined facility operations. With 1,000 employees in 2024, its expanding workforce underscores the company's success in meeting the complex needs of its clients.
